_comment: Credentials ALLOWED to make successful Gemini (generativelanguage) calls on the
Google project that funds the production bot. Read by scripts/llm_provider_reconcile.py.
Entries carry sha256(credential_uid)[:16], NOT the uid itself: this repo is public, and
an infrastructure identifier does not need to travel with it. The uid is not a secret
(it authenticates nothing) — this is minimisation, not secrecy.
To declare a credential you have decided is legitimate:
and add it below WITH a label saying what spends on it and who owns it.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (2026-08-12): a dev key created on M5 for a verifier A/B made 5,344
successful billable calls over three days, none of them visible to the cost ledger, and
drained the prepay balance the production WhatsApp bot spends from — the bot went silent.
Every repo-side cost check reads the ledger, so every one of them was blind by
construction. Google's Cloud Monitoring is the independent observer.
